C0417.title: 2FA Bypass Attack Using MitM Phishing Kits
C0417.summary: In February 2022, security researchers discovered multiple websites using man-in-the-middle (MitM) phishing kits capable of intercepting two-factor authentication (2FA) security codes, allowing cybercriminals to bypass this verification step and take over user accounts.
